Videos go in too.

## Download

- **galleryLAB-setup.exe** installs galleryLAB for your Windows account, over an existing copy in the same
  folder. If you have 0.1.1 or later, galleryLAB installs this update by itself.
- **galleryLAB-portable.exe** runs without installing and replaces itself when a new version comes out.

Requires Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. Windows SmartScreen may say the build isn't recognised; choose **More
info**, then **Run anyway**.

## What's new

- **Video import.** Drop MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM or AVI files (or folders holding them) like photos. Each video
  gets a poster frame in the contact sheet with its length underneath, its original is copied into the
  project untouched, and the import panel counts photos and videos separately. A damaged video, or one in a
  format galleryLAB can't read, is listed under Issues with a plain reason.
- **Add photos and videos** in one picker.
